intent: A ring of rime highland round one frozen lake, its road coming in along a shore and crossing the ice at a narrow neck beside the runestone ring, so from above the pale lake fills the bowl and the road threads its narrows.
requests: A seamless flat ice-sheet sculpt for tiling: rimeholt_ice is a pool of lobes, so a lake laid from it shows overlapping circles from above.
A way for a large tiled ground landmark to opt out of the scale-derived keep-out, so ice can cover a lake without stripping the whole shore of dressing props.
